name: scroll-site
title: Scroll website
about: A product page with a real 3D speaker behind the text. As you scroll, it turns, moves to the other side and lights up on the beat; the background colour changes with each section.
aboutKo: 글 뒤에 진짜 3D 스피커가 있는 제품 페이지예요. 스크롤하면 스피커가 돌고, 반대편으로 옮겨 가고, 박자에 맞춰 불이 들어와요. 섹션마다 배경색도 바뀌어요.
prompt: Make a product landing page where a 3D speaker sits behind the text. When I scroll, it turns, moves to the other side of the page and its front glows to a beat.
promptKo: 글 뒤에 3D 스피커가 떠 있는 제품 소개 페이지 만들어 줘. 스크롤하면 스피커가 돌면서 반대편으로 옮겨 가고, 앞면이 박자에 맞춰 빛나게 해 줘.

sources.name: tsogjavklann/awwwards-3d, coin-scroll template
sources.what: the page: fixed canvas behind HTML sections, warm three-point light, shadow floor, bloom + vignette + grain, damped scroll values

sources.name: Khronos glTF Sample Assets, BoomBox by Microsoft
sources.what: the speaker (assets/boombox.glb, textures resized to 1024 px)

replaces: The template uses GSAP (its own non-MIT licence) and Lenis; here the scroll is read with plain JavaScript, so there is nothing extra to install.
